title: Annual Number of Single Unwed Mothers
what_it_is: Annual Number of Single Unwed Mothers

sections.label: Benefits for citizen children
sections.summary: The Government extends child benefits to citizen children regardless of mothers' marital status, and single unwed mothers in financial difficulty may seek assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Government has extended to citizen children all benefits that support child growth, development and caregiving, regardless of the marital status of their mothers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: These include the Child Development Account (CDA), subsidies for education, healthcare, childcare and infant care, and the foreign domestic worker levy concession.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Single unwed mothers who are in financial difficulty may also approach the Social Service Offices (SSOs) for financial assistance and also, be referred to Family Service Centres (FSCs) or other agencies for further support.

sections.label: Single unwed mothers numbers
sections.summary: Numbers of single unwed mothers were above a thousand yearly from 2006 to 2012, and under a thousand yearly from 2013, with 2016 to 2020 figures given.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Based on the numbers I have, for single unwed mothers, between the years 2006 and 2012, the numbers have been above a thousand a year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The Member has specifically asked for the numbers in the past five years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I mentioned this because, actually, after 2012, starting from 2013, the average number of single unwed mothers per year has been less than a thousand per year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And, specifically, for the last five years that the Member has enquired about, in 2016, the number is 843; in 2017, 805; in 2018, 891; in 2019, 783; and in 2020, 859.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, we can see that from 2006 to 2020, it looks like the numbers on average have come down.

sections.label: Housing application for single unwed mothers
sections.summary: No single unwed mother will be turned away at the onset from applying for housing.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: No single unwed mother will be turned away at the onset from applying for housing.
